name: schedule-sage-ack-fix
title: Fix declined shift query and polish schedule manager
description: Normalize the declined acknowledgement enum at the Apollo transport boundary and align the schedule workspace with the cool sage manager palette.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Completed. ShiftAcknowledgements status values are normalized to uppercase before transport, so the lowercase caller no longer fails GraphQL enum validation. The final schedule theme loads after legacy styles, removes the beige canvas, widens the weekly board, keeps shift cards mostly white, and improves declined-review spacing. Schema, resolver normalization, MongoDB query, permissions, schedule lifecycle, and mutations are unchanged. The focused Vitest test was added but not executed because this connector environment has no runnable checkout. No GitHub status checks were available.
